links.outcome: Site-specific performance differences of RAG-augmented protocol prediction across three Mayo Clinic sites
links.effect: RAG improved macro F1 at Arizona (Δ=0.0306, p=0.0074) and Florida (Δ=0.0245, p=0.0217); at Rochester no macro F1 gain and weighted F1 degraded (Δ=-0.0180).
links.quote: However, at Rochester, RAG showed no macro F1 improvement and significantly degraded weighted F1 ( Δ =-0.0180, p=1.0000), indicating site-specific heterogeneity in RAG effectiveness.
